name: retromod
description: RETROMOD (@retromod.za) mid-century furniture & Hi-Fi e-commerce storefront

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),cp=require('child_process');const walk=d=>fs.existsSync(d)?fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true}).flatMap(e=>e.isDirectory()?walk(path.join(d,e.name)):path.join(d,e.name)):[];const js=['server.js',...walk('api'),...walk('scripts'),...walk('lib'),...walk('site/public/assets/js'),...walk('tests/unit')].filter(f=>f.endsWith('.js'));for(const f of js){const r=cp.spawnSync(process.execPath,['--check',f],{stdio:'inherit'});if(r.status)process.exit(r.status);}const cat=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('data/seed-catalog.json','utf8'));if(!Array.isArray(cat.products)||!cat.products.length)throw new Error('Empty seed-catalog');for(const p of cat.products){const img=path.join('site/public',p.image);if(!fs.existsSync(img))throw new Error('Missing stock image: '+img);}if(fs.existsSync('site/public/_frame.html'))throw new Error('_frame.html must not be in site/public');console.log('Build check passed:',js.length,'JS files,',cat.products.length,'products');"
scripts.lint: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),cp=require('child_process');const walk=d=>fs.existsSync(d)?fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true}).flatMap(e=>e.isDirectory()?walk(path.join(d,e.name)):path.join(d,e.name)):[];const js=['server.js',...walk('api'),...walk('scripts'),...walk('lib'),...walk('site/public/assets/js'),...walk('tests/unit')].filter(f=>f.endsWith('.js'));for(const f of js){const r=cp.spawnSync(process.execPath,['--check',f],{stdio:'inherit'});if(r.status)process.exit(r.status);}for(const j of ['package.json','vercel.json','data/seed-catalog.json'])JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(j,'utf8'));const bad=[...walk('data'),...walk('site/public')].filter(f=>/\.(json|html|js)$/i.test(f)&&/scontent-|cdninstagram\.com/i.test(fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8')));if(bad.length)throw new Error('Expiring IG CDN URLs found in: '+bad.join(', '));console.log('Lint passed');"
scripts.test:unit: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),cp=require('child_process');const walk=d=>fs.existsSync(d)?fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true}).flatMap(e=>e.isDirectory()?walk(path.join(d,e.name)):path.join(d,e.name)):[];const files=walk('tests/unit').filter(f=>f.endsWith('.test.js'));if(!files.length)throw new Error('No unit test files found');const r=cp.spawnSync(process.execPath,['--test',...files],{stdio:'inherit'});process.exit(r.status??1);"
